sources.snippet: OpenThinkerAgent-8B-ColdStartSFTForRL is the cold-start, pre-RL base of the OpenThoughts-Agent 8B SFT→RL recipe. It is post-trained from Qwen/Qwen3-8B with full-parameter SFT on the cold-start OpenThoughts-Agent-SFT-ColdStartForRL-10K dataset.
